requirement: The framework shall let multiple PlugIt Services be presented through a shared user experience mediated by a PlugIt Proxy while preserving each service's data and process boundaries. External users or systems shall access the services through the proxy, which shall communicate with services through the PlugIt protocol.

Operators shall be able to configure services for different deployment environments through project and local configuration, including database connections, debug settings, base paths, and allowed networks. Private settings shall be kept in local configuration excluded from source control, and services using the allowed-network setting shall enforce the configured CIDR restrictions.

Services shall be configurable with the PlugIt Proxy URL for their deployment and shall be able to use a common programmatic client to access supported proxy capabilities for user information, subscription tags, organizations, project members, email sending, and forum topics.

Database-backed services shall use their own configured database connections and support versioned schema upgrades through Alembic migration files. Schema changes shall be represented by upgrade files that can be applied consistently across development and production environments.
